title: Exactness of the supplied integral stage identity
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme T with l invertible in every stalk. Let stage_E be a family of FdRationalStageComparison data [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. For each finite coefficient field E in Ω, stage_E.integral.functor is triangulated for its supplied integral_shift structure. The integral identity and its specified shift normalization identify its composite with the full PBC inclusion with the intrinsic exact coefficient restriction.

proof.text:
the full intrinsic integral inclusion and the exact coefficient restriction
induce an exact derived composite J. The supplied integral_identity identifies I
followed by the PBC inclusion with J. Equality elimination and the supplied
integral_shift_normalization identify their two integer-shift structures, so this
identity is an exact natural isomorphism. The target full inclusion is exact and
fully faithful; reflection of distinguished triangles gives exactness of I.

theorem fdIntegralStageExact
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [dT : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [iT : Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (stage : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, FdRationalStageComparison l Ω T E)
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) : (stage E).integral.functor.IsTriangulated
